baseline: current Pine defaults via frozen timing-study Python baseline
data_inputs: cached audited time/OHLC/features from prior experiment; raw file size/mtime rechecked before reuse
entry_rules: same baseline preparation and close-inside-band signal; freeze limit=signal_close-side*k*priorATR; next bar onward live for ttl bars; opening improvement allowed; order removed after ttl-th bar if unfilled
price_quantization: before results, user director required broker tick grid: buy limit=floor(raw_limit/tick)*tick, sell limit=ceil(raw_limit/tick)*tick; tick from symbol metadata decimals, never round toward market
pending_cancel: Before intrabar fill: opening already reaches previous-confirmed target => cancel. If no fill and intrabar target reached => cancel. After unfilled bar close: gap, same-side impulse, same-side long-wick touch, opposite-band touch, or close crossing new SMA cancels for subsequent bars. No new preparation on cancellation bar. No duplicate preparations while pending.
ambiguity: If entry occurs intrabar, do NOT execute target on same bar even if touched; hold and update next target. If opening fills limit, samebar target is allowed. Count ambiguous bars. All adverse continuations retained.

exit_rules.reward_risk_ratio: user moving SMA20 full exit, not fixed RR
exit_rules.update: next bar uses latest confirmed SMA

period_semantics: independent flat portfolios per year; full-period continuous separate
cost_and_fill_model: fixed1.4pips and metadata spread/pip+0.2; cost deducted once at settlement; raw OHLC limit fills; no limit queue model; no swaps
position_sizing_and_currency: one fixed-unit position each symbol; equal-pip research score, not account profit
selection: Training only: both cost cases net>0, net+open>0, >=40 trades and >=6/9 positive pairs. Rank minimum train net across both costs descending then id ascending. Select at most one. No fallback after validation/final.
evaluation_access: All candidates train; only baseline + selected access validation/final/continuous. No selected means baseline-only later descriptive results.
acceptance_gates: Both cost models: all evaluated periods net and net+open positive; continuous >=100 trades and >=6/9 positive pairs; final >=30 trades and >=6/9 positive pairs
cross_symbol_rule: same single candidate on all nine symbols; no symbol postselection
code_identifier: runner saves protocol, source modules and cached features SHA256 before outcomes
stop_rule: six new candidates maximum; train failure or validation/final gate failure => REJECTED; no further tuning
